summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, announcing a press release detailing the successful outcome of an open season for its proposed Prairie Connector pipeline project. The open season secured 20-year binding commitments for firm transportation service from Hardisty, Alberta to U.S. delivery points, with a final investment decision targeted for mid-2027. This is an operational and project-development update, not a corporate special situation. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report and contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst.
